## Executive Summary

This plan addresses the 3 NEW actionable items from today's research plus 2 HIGH-PRIORITY carry-forward items from the backlog. All 5 issues are focused on improving error handling, user visibility, and provider compatibility — core quality and UX improvements that don't require new major features.

**Priority distribution**:
- HIGH: 2 issues (~7-10h) — content-filter detection, compaction trigger fix
- MEDIUM: 3 issues (~4-6h) — scheduled session display, prompt cache gating, model-list error surfacing

---

## Development Roadmap

### Phase 1: Error Handling & Retry Logic (HIGH)

#### 1.1 Content-Filter Finish Reason Detection
- **What**: Detect `content-filter` finish reason and skip wasteful retries
- **Why**: Currently Alexi retries filtered turns 3 times (wasting quota) and shows generic "empty response" instead of "Model content filter blocked this request"
- **Files**: `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` L869-982, `src/core/agenticChat.ts` L792-818
- **Estimated effort**: ~3-4h
- **Category**: provider (finish reason handling)
- **Source**: Cline PR #13302 (2026-09-29)

#### 1.2 Compaction Trigger Token Counts (CARRY-FORWARD)
- **What**: Fix compaction trigger to use provider token counts instead of character heuristics
- **Why**: Open issue #1879, existing implementation uses character counts which diverge from actual model tokenization
- **Files**: `src/compaction/` (trigger logic)
- **Estimated effort**: ~4-6h
- **Category**: core (compaction)
- **Source**: Issue #1879 (carry-forward from previous research)

---

### Phase 2: User Visibility & CLI Enhancements (MEDIUM)

#### 2.1 Scheduled Session Status Display
- **What**: Show "Next wake: <timestamp>" for scheduled sessions in CLI/TUI listings
- **Why**: Users can't see when scheduled sessions will auto-resume despite full wakeup infrastructure existing
- **Files**: `src/cli/commands/sessions.ts` L136-153, `src/cli/tui/dialogs/SessionList.tsx`
- **Estimated effort**: ~2-3h
- **Category**: cli (session listing)
- **Source**: Kilocode PR #14547 (2026-09-28)

#### 2.2 Model-List Error Surfacing (CARRY-FORWARD)
- **What**: Surface model-list endpoint errors in TUI and CLI instead of silent failures
- **Why**: Users don't know why model selection fails when SAP AI Core endpoint is unreachable
- **Files**: TUI model selection dialogs, CLI model list command
- **Estimated effort**: ~2-4h
- **Category**: provider (error visibility)
- **Source**: Carry-forward from 2026-09-24 research

---

### Phase 3: Provider Compatibility (MEDIUM)

#### 3.1 Prompt Cache Breakpoint Gating
- **What**: Gate prompt cache breakpoints to first-party OpenAI (`api.openai.com`), not custom compatible endpoints
- **Why**: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints may not support cache breakpoints, causing silent failures
- **Files**: `src/providers/openai/prompt-cache.ts` L40-49
- **Estimated effort**: ~2-3h
- **Category**: provider (cache logic)
- **Source**: Kilocode PR #13321 (2026-09-28)

## Quality Gates (per issue)

Each implementation MUST pass:
1. `npm run lint` (0 errors)
2. `npm run typecheck` (strict, no `@ts-ignore`)
3. `npm run format:check` (prettier conformance)
4. `npm run test:coverage` (≥40% line coverage maintained)
5. `npm run build` (dist/ emits cleanly)

---

## Dependencies & Constraints

- **No breaking changes**: All enhancements are backward-compatible
- **No new major dependencies**: Use existing infrastructure (wakeup API, provider abstractions, finish reason enums)
- **Test coverage**: Each PR must include unit tests for new logic paths
- **ESM conventions**: All new imports must end in `.js`
- **Commit format**: `feat|fix(scope): subject [alexi-bot]` with allowed scopes from `commitlint.config.cjs`
